reviewScope: All 30 complete articles read back in three groups of ten; four edited articles read again in full. Complete six Zhengyi lines and small images consulted, fixed chart facts and every qi node checked; no extra literary AI pass.

九五土令标题改为“有助可查，接回仍需逐步办实”，补清行动及结果。

majorEvidenceReview: 初六不永所事不是停止寻找，终吉依辨明止争；九二归逋非宠物回家，三百户非搜索人数或范围，记录断句版本差别；六三无成依不自成不争功语境，不抹贞厉终吉；九四渝改守理不许必得；九五元吉中正与四关系旺衰共读；上九不保警意不抹前后金生体，亦不以双生数量扩大。各月结论回应本用、两互、末势与反证。
timingReview: 26 manuscripts have one named conditional stage event, at most two dates; four omit with exact lack-of-day-rule reasons. Windows only verification, help or process obstruction, not guaranteed reunion or fate; no ancient number becomes real period.
imageryReview: True use and changed use only; actual water fixtures, metal hardware, wood rails, planar or rectangular fixtures and real red signs/windows distinguished from unknown animal attributes or location. No species, wounds, theft, headcounts or assumed past event.
